title: Abandoned contact encryption publisher resumes after catalog repair
fault_primitive: recurring authenticated encryption of the existing MongoDB hotel address field from a detached cross-service publisher
incident_class: cancelled client-side encryption migration with an unmanaged reconciliation process
symptoms: Search and recommendation requests lose their HTTP connection when frontend GeoJSON rendering encounters a hotel without its decoded address. Frontend runtime-error log volume rises sharply. All application pods remain Running and Ready; profile RPCs themselves return successfully and the profile database remains reachable.
